installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -e

echo "========================================"
echo " [1/5] Installing required tools..."
echo "========================================"

apt update
apt install -y git
npm install -g pnpm@latest

echo "========================================"
echo " [2/5] Preparing server directory..."
echo "========================================"

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

echo "========================================"
echo " [3/5] Downloading server files..."
echo "========================================"

if [ -d .git ]; then
  ORIGIN="$(git config --get remote.origin.url || true)"

  if [ "$ORIGIN" = "$GIT_ADDRESS" ]; then
    echo "Pulling latest changes..."
    git pull
  else
    echo "Existing Git repository uses a different remote; leaving files unchanged."
  fi
elif [ -z "$(ls -A /mnt/server 2>/dev/null)" ]; then
  if [ -n "$BRANCH" ]; then
    echo "Cloning branch: $BRANCH"
    git clone --single-branch --branch "$BRANCH" "$GIT_ADDRESS" .
  else
    echo "Cloning default branch..."
    git clone "$GIT_ADDRESS" .
  fi
else
  echo "ERROR: /mnt/server is not empty and is not a Git repository."
  exit 10
fi

echo "========================================"
echo " [4/5] Creating environment file..."
echo "========================================"

if [ -f .env.example ] && [ ! -f .env ]; then
  cp .env.example .env
  echo "Created .env from .env.example."
else
  echo "Keeping existing .env configuration."
fi

echo "========================================"
echo " [5/5] Installing Node.js dependencies..."
echo "========================================"

pnpm install

echo "========================================"
echo " Installation complete."
echo "========================================"

exit 0
